title: Compaction keeps an early decision
checks: A decision made at the start of a long chat survives compaction: it is still sent to the model and recalled afterwards.
why: Long chats get compacted; if the summary drops what was agreed early on, the assistant quietly goes back on it.

case.name: Compaction keeps an early decision
case.about: The decision {{fact}} survives compaction of a long chat about {{topic}}.
